Coefficient of variation (CV): The ratio of the standard deviation to the mean, expressed as a percentage. It is useful for comparing the variability of different datasets, and it gives us a simple idea of the relative dispersion. 8. Range (R): The difference between the highest and lowest values in the dataset, expressed as an absolute value. It gives us an idea of the most extreme values, and thus the range of variability.
